LanguageData.GM21_Achieved_Default: Grandmaster\nThis pawn has achieved Grandmaster mastery in this skill.\nThis level is permanent: it does not decay and cannot be lost.
LanguageData.GM21_Achieved_Shooting:
Grandmaster Marksman
This pawn has transcended ordinary ranged combat mastery. They compensate almost perfectly for weapon inaccuracy, ignore cover and ordinary environmental aim penalties, aim and recover between shots with extraordinary speed, and may deliberately target lethal or incapacitating anatomy - re-aiming between every shot of a burst.
Range, damage and armour are unchanged: the mastery is the marksman's, not the bullet's.
This level is permanent: it does not decay and cannot be lost.
LanguageData.GM21_Achieved_Crafting: Grandmaster\nThis pawn has transcended normal mastery of this skill. Only a Grandmaster can produce Legendary-quality work.\nThis level is permanent: it does not decay and cannot be lost.
LanguageData.GM21_Achieved_Artistic: Grandmaster\nThis pawn has transcended normal mastery of this skill. Only a Grandmaster can produce Legendary-quality work.\nThis level is permanent: it does not decay and cannot be lost.
LanguageData.GM21_Achieved_Construction: Grandmaster\nThis pawn has transcended normal mastery of this skill. Only a Grandmaster can produce Legendary-quality work.\nThis level is permanent: it does not decay and cannot be lost.
LanguageData.GM21_AimMode_GizmoDesc: Choose where this Grandmaster Marksman aims.\n\nAll modes keep the passive Grandmaster bonuses. Only shot placement changes.
LanguageData.GM21_AimMode_KillerDesc: Deliberately aim for the anatomy most likely to kill the target quickly. The weapon still decides the damage.
LanguageData.GM21_AimMode_DownedDesc: Dynamically aim for the least-lethal useful anatomy - mobility first, then manipulation, then non-vital extremities - avoiding vital organs. Re-aimed after every shot, and firing stops once the target is down.\n\nNot a guarantee of survival: the target may still die of blood loss or untreated wounds.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_RequirementDesc: Extra experience a pawn must earn after reaching level 20 before becoming a Grandmaster.\nCurrent: {0} XP. Allowed range: {1} - {2}.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_DeterministicQualityDesc: Pawn-created quality is decided by skill band instead of a random roll:\n0-3 Awful, 4-7 Poor, 8-10 Normal, 11-13 Good, 14-16 Excellent, 17-20 Masterwork, 21 Legendary.\nTurning this off restores vanilla's random roll for levels 0-20, capped at Masterwork. Level 21 always produces Legendary either way.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_ShowProgressDesc: Adds Grandmaster progress to the skill tooltip and a star beside a Grandmaster skill.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_PermanenceNote: Level 21 is permanent. Once earned it never decays and ordinary gameplay cannot reduce it. Skills at level 20 and below decay exactly as in vanilla.
LanguageData.GM21_Maintenance_Desc: Converts Grandmaster21-specific state back into vanilla-safe values for the current loaded game. Use this only before removing Grandmaster 21 from your mod list.
LanguageData.GM21_Uninstall_NoGame: Load the save you intend to clean before using Prepare Save for Uninstall.\n\nThis operation works on the game that is currently loaded. Nothing has been changed.
LanguageData.GM21_Uninstall_ConfirmBody:
This operation is intended only before removing Grandmaster 21 from your mod list.

It will modify the currently loaded game by:

 - changing every level 21 skill to level 20
 - clearing all stored Grandmaster XP/progress
 - removing Grandmaster21-specific skill state where applicable

This cannot be undone except by reloading an earlier save.

After cleanup:

 1. Save the game.
 2. Exit RimWorld.
 3. Disable/remove Grandmaster 21.
 4. Reload the cleaned save.
